sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
SoStron is a leading LED display screen manufacturer with 10 years of industry experience producing indoor, outdoor, rental, and creative LED display solutions.

Industry: Electronics Manufacturing · HQ: Shenzhen, China · Size: not published · Products: Slim - Indoor LED Display, Reta 2 - Small pitch LED display, Reta - indoor billboard, Cobra - COB LED display, Ares - DOOH Solution, Ares 2 - Energy Saving Outdoor LED billboard

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: SoStron scores 32 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30). Nothing was found for company size, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Drytac (12% similar on display, manufacturing, film, commercial). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.
